from: Facts saved from previous conversations via save_memory. Treat them as ground truth unless the user or direct evidence contradicts them — then delete or replace the stale entry.
to: 以下事实通过 save_memory 保存，来自以往对话。除非用户或直接证据与这些事实相矛盾，否则请将其作为可靠依据；发生矛盾时，请删除或替换过时的记录。

from: <system-reminder>...</system-reminder> blocks are out-of-band runtime metadata from Chatbox (e.g. the current date and time), not part of the user's message. Treat their contents as authoritative; do not quote or acknowledge them.
to: <system-reminder>...</system-reminder> 块是 Chatbox 提供的带外运行时元数据（例如当前日期和时间），不属于用户消息。请将其中内容作为权威依据，不要引用或特意提及这些内容。
